name: The St. Regis Rome
insider_take: Where Roman grandeur meets legendary St. Regis service in the heart of the Eternal City
whats_special: This palatial hotel occupies a prime position just steps from the Spanish Steps and Via del Corso, housed in a magnificently restored 19th-century building. The property features the signature St. Regis Butler Service and boasts one of Rome's most acclaimed rooftop restaurants with panoramic views of the city's ancient skyline.
pro_tip: Request a room on the upper floors for glimpses of iconic Roman landmarks, and make dinner reservations at the rooftop restaurant well in advance – it's consistently rated among Rome's best dining experiences.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to the Trevi Fountain (5-minute walk), the Pantheon (10 minutes), and exclusive shopping on Via dei Condotti. The concierge can arrange private after-hours access to Vatican museums and skip-the-line entries to the Colosseum.
pros: Prime location near Via Veneto and Spanish Steps
Legendary St. Regis Butler Service available 24/7
Exquisite classic Roman architecture and elegant interiors
Michelin-starred dining and sophisticated rooftop bar
cons: Historic building may have smaller room configurations
